description: This file defines an abstract base class 'PluginSettingsBase' for Drupal's Field API plugins, handling plugin settings including default, third-party, and dependency management.

classes.name: PluginSettingsBase
classes.description: Abstract class for managing plugin settings with support for default, third-party, and dependency handling within Drupal's Field API.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default settings as an empty array.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Returns current plugin settings, merging defaults if not already merged.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Retrieves a specific setting by key, merging defaults if necessary.

methods.name: mergeDefaults
methods.description: Merges default settings into current settings.

methods.name: setSettings
methods.description: Sets multiple settings at once and resets merge flag.

methods.name: setSetting
methods.description: Sets a single setting by key.

methods.name: getThirdPartySettings
methods.description: Retrieves third-party settings, optionally for a specific module.

methods.name: getThirdPartySetting
methods.description: Retrieves a specific third-party setting for a module.

methods.name: setThirdPartySetting
methods.description: Sets a third-party setting for a module.

methods.name: unsetThirdPartySetting
methods.description: Removes a third-party setting for a module, deleting the module array if empty.

methods.name: getThirdPartyProviders
methods.description: Returns list of modules providing third-party settings.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Creates dependencies on modules providing third-party settings.

methods.name: onDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Removes dependencies on specified modules and updates third-party settings accordingly.
